messages:
Elaine: Quick sync — building a 'post lifespan' retarget playbook for the launch. Need cadence for X + LinkedIn, rules for when to retarget engaged users, and webinar attendee follow-ups. Thoughts?
Sam: Love it. Proposed cadence: Day 0 (launch), Day 2 (reminder), Day 5 (case study), Day 10 (webinar invite). Short variants for X, longer for LinkedIn.
Priya: For creatives, we need 2 hero images + 3 carousel cards. Can we get assets by EOD Tue? @Matt you on design?
Matt: Yep, I'll do hero images + alt copy. ETA Tue 4pm. Will drop Figma link to the channel when ready.
Elaine: Perfect. Can we A/B CTA messaging: 'Try Redwood Inference' vs 'See latency benchmarks' — which should drive demo signups vs benchmark reads?
Sam: I'd route benchmark-focused clicks to the blog (UTM=benchmark_social) and demo CTAs to webinar sign-up / demo form. Also recommend shorter CTAs on X.
Priya: For retarget rules: anyone who clicks a post OR watches >20s of video -> add to 'warm' audience. Warm gets webinar invite 48h after launch. Cold gets a 2-week nurture sequence.
campaign-bot: Scheduled posts created: X launch (2791234567.001), LinkedIn launch (2791234567.002). Dashboard: /campaigns/launch-2791
Elaine: For inbound lead routing: warm leads -> SDR queue 'launch-warm'; webinar RSVPs -> AE follow-up flagged. Ops, can we add a webhook to forward warm leads?
Sam: I'll open a ticket with infra and include the routing matrix. Quick snippet for routing config: 
```
route: \"warm\" -> queue: launch-warm
rsvp: true -> flag: AE-followup
```
Matt: Figma link: https://figma.com/file/xyz (assets in /marketing/launch/) — I'll upload final export to the shared drive.
Priya: Also want engagement follow-ups: day-after webinar send short clip + CTA; day+3: case study snippet. Assign @Elaine to confirm copy and @Sam to confirm UTM tracking.
Elaine: I'll draft copy by Wed morning and share a short messaging matrix (3 CTAs x 2 audiences). Thanks everyone :rocket:
Sam: LGTM :thumbsup:
Priya: Copying notes to the launch doc and adding the retarget rules to the automation playbook.
